_comment: Literal strings that identify you, matched case-insensitively against text
the AI pass transcribed off your photos. A photo whose transcript contains
one is withheld from day summaries, so it can never be paraphrased into
generated prose. The photo, its caption and its transcript stay in the
archive and still show in the album - this hides nothing from you.
Your own name is the main thing worth putting here: no pattern can find a
name generically, and it is what a boarding pass, a delivery label or a
hotel confirmation puts in large print. Passport and card numbers are
already detected by shape and need no entry.
Entries under 3 characters are ignored. This file is local only - it is
never uploaded to OneDrive and never sent to a model.
Run `npm run --workspace pipeline redact` after editing.
terms: any other literal string redact should always withhold
